I'm an Assistant Teaching Professor in the Applied Mathematics & Statistics department at
Johns Hopkins University.

Most of my energy goes into looking for ways to make mathematics land better --- inside my own
courses and, where I can, more broadly. I build [interactive visualizations](projects/visual-math-lab.qmd)
for teaching, [redesign courses](projects/index.qmd) from the ground up, and occasionally
[formalize mathematics](projects/lean-formalization.qmd) in the Lean theorem prover.

Whether you're a student, a mathematician, or an educator, feel free to
[get in touch](mailto:apurva.nakade@jhu.edu).

**Note.** I'm currently in the progress of updating this website using Claude. Turns out Claude is much faster than me! As a consequence, I'm lagging behind by a lot in reviewing and updating the content. Much of the content is outdated and I apologize for that.
